mapper.select: SELECT title AS `name`, `sort` AS `value` FROM screen_left_two_type ORDER BY sort ASC;

SELECT sdi.title AS xData, sm.title AS `name`, CONCAT(sm.color_one, ',', sm.color_two) AS colors, IFNULL(SUM(sd.value), 0) AS `value` FROM screen_left_two_type sdi LEFT JOIN screen_left_two_data sd ON sdi.id = sd.class_name LEFT JOIN screen_left_two_main sm ON sd.group_id = sm.id WHERE `type` = #{type} GROUP BY sdi.title, sm.title, sm.color_one, sm.color_two, sm.sort ORDER BY sm.sort ASC;
